title: PSG4-C4096-BANK: linear classical bits and quadratic counted qubits at the near-unit retry profile

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE physical PSG4-C4096-BANK interpreter in proof.md executing the complete scoped virtual program V in virtual.md recovers the entire s from independent ideal copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY execution branch including failed attempts, wrong extracted labels, rejected/discarded copies, both virtual cutoff aborts, bank initialization, padding and output-first cleanup, total sequential paid work T is O(2^((365149/500000)sqrt(n log2 n))), with exact growth index 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. The structured declaration is exactly this complete envelope. The basis-bank prefix, every coherent and unused padded wire, controller/input/output, fixed dense regions and allocator/record metadata are counted in one physical configuration. There is one physical source request per virtual request. The full CQ and paid-overhead proof uses V's stricter internal height bound; it does not discard a polynomial multiplying the final pure exponential. Correctness includes the finite branch; asymptotic envelopes have a positive finite-prefix extension. All four resources and clean-only fraction0 hold jointly for this same physical interpreter.
